population_description: Synthetic ship-design records supplied as the complete nltl:ship population of each input. External legal/application eligibility and the experimental source-edition selection are research assumptions, not facts inferred from RDF. This is not real-vessel certification. The population includes incomplete, inconsistent and unrecognized-value records; represented correctness is not assumed. Conditions inside the represented requirement, effective activation, missing represented inputs, paths, units, datatypes and query correctness remain for generated SHACL to address from supplied source/schema. The represented domain is the I2.2.5 bottom/lower-region boundary on externally assumed Polar Class design records. Linked hull-boundary-point records and inclination quantities are supplied observations/claims about this boundary. This does not independently reconstruct a hull surface or verify that the submitted point set is physically complete. The source-defined boundary condition remains in scope; its satisfaction is not an eligibility assumption.
